description: Transform your Power BI reports with InfoGraphica by IFour – an advanced custom visual designed to represent data using customizable icons. Instead of relying solely on traditional bar or column charts, InfoGraphica enables you to display values as icon-based representations, making comparisons more intuitive, engaging, and visually appealing. With flexible customization options, InfoGraphica is ideal for representing quantities, hierarchies, and relationships, while maintaining interactivity and professional styling. Key features Icon-Based Visualization-: Represent values using icons instead of bars or numbers. Value per Icon Setting-: Define how much each icon represents (e.g., 1 icon = 1000 units). Customizable Icon Presets-: Choose from built-in icons (Users, Hospital, Money, etc.). Custom SVG Support-: Add your own SVG icon code for fully personalized visuals. Custom Styling Options-: Control filled (selected) , partially filled(unselected) and background colors. Responsive Layout-: Works seamlessly across report sizes with scrollable containers. Interactive Visuals-: Explore relationships dynamically with engaging visual interactions. Business use cases Human Resources-: Visualize employee counts, team structures, or resource allocation.
